LESSON: LEVERS AS SIMPLE MACHINES

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
Strand: Force and Energy
Topic 3.2: Levers as simple machines

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Levers as simple machines
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How are levers used in day to day life?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify common levers used in day- to-day life
2. describe parts of a lever as used in making work easier
3. classify levers into the three classes
4. demonstrate the use of levers in making work easier
5. appreciate the use of levers in making work easier

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Levers as simple machines

Teach
• Observe Levers as simple machines in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Levers as simple machines (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Levers as simple machines.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Levers as simple machines.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Levers as simple machines.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• identify common levers used in day- to-day life
• describe parts of a lever as used in making work easier
• classify levers into the three classes

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Levers as simple machines.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Levers as simple machines: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How are levers used in day to day life?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• identify common levers used in day- to-day life
• describe parts of a lever as used in making work easier
• classify levers into the three classes
• demonstrate the use of levers in making work easier

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
